import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyLocalEquation
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.StalksDVR

/-!
# Finite length on Cartier divisor charts

On an affine open of dimension at most one, a regular Cartier equation
has a finite-length quotient.  The comparison below uses the actual quotient
map and is compatible with restriction to smaller affine opens inside a
kernel-trivializing chart.  It supplies the local multiplicities needed to
associate a Weil divisor to Kleiman's invertible ideal (`sb:ediv`).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierKernel

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {E F : X.Modules}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On an affine open, the actual Cartier quotient is the coordinate ring
modulo the restricted equation. -/
noncomputable def quotientSectionsEquiv (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q]
    [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (eO : E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (eI : kernel q ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    (Γ(X, U) ⧸ Ideal.span
      {X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op (localEquation q eO eI)})
      ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(F, U) := by
  let q' := eO.inv ≫ q
  haveI : (kernel q).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso eI.symm
      (Modules.unit_isQuasicoherent X)
  haveI : (kernel q').IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      (kernelIsIsoComp eO.inv q).symm inferInstance
  have hs : Function.Surjective (q'.val.app (op U)).hom :=
    section_surjective_of_epi_qcoh q' hU
  have hk : LinearMap.ker (q'.val.app (op U)).hom =
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
        (localEquation q eO eI)} := by
    ext s
    change q'.val.app (op U) s = 0 ↔
      s ∈ (Ideal.span {X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
        (localEquation q eO eI)} : Ideal Γ(X, U))
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton (α := Γ(X, U))]
    exact quotient_eq_zero_iff_dvd_localEquation q eO eI U s
  exact (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hk.symm).trans
    ((q'.val.app (op U)).hom.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hs)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The length of the actual affine quotient is the order of its equation. -/
theorem length_sections_quotient (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q]
    [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (eO : E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (eI : kernel q ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    Module.length Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) =
      Ring.ord Γ(X, U)
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op (localEquation q eO eI)) :=
  (quotientSectionsEquiv q eO eI U hU).length_eq.symm

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Regularity and dimension one force finite length of the actual Cartier
quotient on a noetherian affine chart. -/
theorem isFiniteLength_sections_quotient (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q]
    [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (eO : E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (eI : kernel q ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U)] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 Γ(X, U)] :
    IsFiniteLength Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) := by
  rw [← Module.length_ne_top_iff, length_sections_quotient q eO eI U hU]
  apply Ring.ord_ne_top
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
  intro s hs
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun t : Γ(X, U) =>
      t * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
        (localEquation q eO eI)) :=
    localEquation_mul_injective q eO eI U
  exact hinj (hs.trans (zero_mul _).symm)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierKernel
